title: The Polymorphic Chiral Anomaly
summary: The chiral anomaly famously manifests in a rich variety of forms, from abelian and singlet to consistent or covariant. In this paper, all these realizations are described in detail, along with their properties and phenomenological applications. Central to this presentation is a novel expression for the fully generic chiral anomaly, derived with either massive or massless fermions, that incorporates not only the standard triangle but also the box and pentagon diagrams.
